biotools.summary: ColiFormer is a transformer-based codon optimization web application (Hugging Face Space) that converts a protein or DNA input sequence into an optimized E. coli coding sequence while balancing CAI, tAI, GC content, RNA stability, and avoidance of negative cis-regulatory elements.
biotools.name: ColiFormer
